writeup.key_factor: World Series Game 5, potential clincher: Milwaukee sends ace Jacob Misiorowski (16-5, 1.80 ERA, 252 K; won Game 1 with 1 run in 5 innings) while Tampa Bay, rotation burned after a 12-inning Game 4, pieces together a bullpen game with no starter announced. Brewers lead the series 3-1 and have won 10 of 12 playoff games.
writeup.risk: Tampa Bay faces elimination at home in a dome and just stole Game 4 in 12 innings, so desperation is real; Junior Caminero plays hurt (left foot). The MLB Elo run is dated 2026-10-26 and does not include WS Game 3 (MIL 10-1) or Game 4 (TB 4-3), so the rating is stale by two games. Price -149 is 1 cent inside the -150 band edge and US-accessible books sit at -155, so the play only holds at -152 or better — the pre-game check must confirm the price.

The price moved from +105 in the morning to +121 at midday, well past the +106 minimum for the 4% NHL gate.

Goalies are likely, not team-confirmed — the pre-game check must confirm Grubauer and Stolarz still start.
